title: Jannat hai karbala
body:
Jannat hai karbala
Hussain hussain hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aate hai zaereen karbobala
haatho'n me leke mishaale wafa
maatami hai ab yaume wila
kaale libaas aur shaale azaa
lab pe sajaye hue ye sadaa
<<MINI>>
jannat hai roza tera, jannat hai puri ye karbobala
ae wallah ae wallah husaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Rasulallah(s.a.w.w.) farmate hai:
"Karbala ki zameen, jannat ke teelo'n me se ek teela hai."
<<MINI>>
karbala jannat hai karbala, wallah
karbala jannat hai karbala
salam husain ya husaina..(2), yabn-ar-rasool ya husaina
salam husain ya husaina..(2), yabn-az-zahra ya husaina
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Aaye ziyarat ko hum, ae wallah
khaate hai teri qasam, ae wallah
matam ye hoga na kam, ae wallah
aankhein rahegi ye nam, ae wallah
<<DIVIDER>>
Imam Jafare Sadiq (a.s.) farmate hai:
" Jis shakhs ko allah khair ataa karna chahta hai uske dil me qabre imam hussain ki shauq daalta hai"
2. Shauqe ziyarat jo tha, ae wallah
maula mai paidal chala, ae wallah
<<DIVIDER>>
khwab ye pura hua, ae wallah
dekha haram to kaha, ae wallah
3. Pani tere shehr ka, ae wallah
kausar se meetha laga, ae wallah
<<DIVIDER>>
uski hawa hai dawa, ae wallah
khaak hai khaak e shifa, ae wallah
4. Jaaye jahan bhi nazar, ae wallah
aaye nazar sar hi sar, ae wallah
<<DIVIDER>>
qudsi wali ya bashar, ae wallah
hai ye sadaa humsafar, ae wallah
Jab hum bainul harmain pohochte hai to jaagta hai dil me ye ehsaas
ek taraf roza e hussain ek taraf roza e abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jannat nahi to aur kya hai
Bainul haramain..(4)
5. Ek taraf darr tera, ae wallah
ek taraf bawafa, ae wallah
<<DIVIDER>>
do jannato ki hawa, ae wallah
ashk huwe lab kusha, ae wallah
6. Roze ka husn hai kya, ae wallah
gumbad arsh e khuda, ae wallah
<<DIVIDER>>
fanoos  shams uz zoha, ae wallah
meenar auj e wafa, ae wallah
aaraish e bamodarr, ae wallah
seera ho jisse nazar, ae wallah
<<DIVIDER>>
nazm hai deewar par, ae wallah
jaise ke shams o qamar, ae wallah
Haaye qateel e jafaa
tu yaha pyaasa raha
<<DIVIDER>>
mujhko sare karbala
koi na pyaasa mila..(2)
7. Ae mere tashna dahan, ae wallah
tu to raha be kafan, ae wallah
<<DIVIDER>>
jaate hai log watan, ae wallah
leke yahan se kafan, ae wallah
8. Haaye shah e karbala
Haaye qateel e jafaa
<<DIVIDER>>
zaero pe tere ek wo waqt tha
haath payro'n ko katwa ke bhi ba khuda
tere roze pe aate the ehle azaa
8. Tujh pe fida kardiye, ae wallah
<<DIVIDER>>
maao'n ne haste huwe, ae wallah
ghar me the jitne diye, ae wallah
bus yahi kehte huwe, ae wallah
9. Farhan o mazhar kaho, ae wallah
<<DIVIDER>>
duniya ko paigham do, ae wallah
roza e sheh pe chalo, ae wallah aur yahi kehte raho, ae wallah
<<MINI>>
jannat hai roza tera, jannat hai puri ye karbobala
ae wallah ae wallah husaina
karbala jannat hai karbala, wallah
karbala jannat hai karbala
salam husain ya husaina..(2), yabn-ar-rasool ya husaina
salam husain ya husaina..(2), yabn-az-zahra ya husaina
Hussain hussain hussain..(2)
